# Metro Valley Digital

> High-Performance Digital Growth Agency & Full-Stack Software House based in Vancouver, BC, Canada.

Metro Valley Digital specializes in ranking local businesses at #1 in the Google Local 3-Pack, scaling multi-platform paid advertising campaigns (Meta, TikTok, Google Ads) with 4x+ ROAS, and engineering custom Next.js web applications and AI chatbot automation systems.

## Primary Services

- [Local SEO & Google 3-Pack Optimization](https://metrovalleydigital.com/local-seo-google-business-profile): Proximity signal optimization, geo-grid tracking, local citation ecosystems, and review velocity funnels for local service businesses across Canada and North America.
- [Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)](https://metrovalleydigital.com/geo-generative-engine-optimization): AI search entity optimization for ChatGPT Search, Google Gemini, and Perplexity AI citations.
- [SEO Services & Organic Growth](https://metrovalleydigital.com/seo-services): Full-funnel technical SEO, topical authority clusters, competitor gap exploitation, and enterprise link acquisition.
- [Website SEO Optimization](https://metrovalleydigital.com/website-seo-optimization): 95+ Core Web Vitals speed optimization, nested JSON-LD schema graphs, and semantic NLP copy alignment.
- [Paid Ads Management (Meta, TikTok, Google Ads)](https://metrovalleydigital.com/paid-advertising-ppc): Data-driven PPC, Performance Max, and social media advertising with server-side CAPI tracking and high-converting direct-response creatives.
- [Social Media Marketing (SMM)](https://metrovalleydigital.com/social-media-marketing): Short-form video production (Reels, TikToks, Shorts), carousel design, and community growth funnels.
- [Custom Next.js & React Web Engineering](https://metrovalleydigital.com/website-development): Modern Jamstack web applications, lightning-fast loading speeds, headless CMS, and conversion-optimized architectures.
- [AI Website Builder Solutions](https://metrovalleydigital.com/ai-website-building): Rapid modern website deployment leveraging cutting-edge AI scaffolding and custom bespoke UI engineering.
- [Shopify & E-Commerce Development](https://metrovalleydigital.com/shopify-ecommerce-development): Conversion-optimized Shopify stores, checkout funnels, and app integrations.
- [Mobile Application Development](https://metrovalleydigital.com/mobile-app-development): iOS and Android cross-platform mobile apps engineered with Flutter and React Native.
- [AI Chatbots & Conversational Agents](https://metrovalleydigital.com/ai-chatbot-integration): Custom 24/7 AI chatbot agents and digital lead qualification systems integrated with WhatsApp and CRM.
- [Amazon & eBay Product Research](https://metrovalleydigital.com/amazon-ebay-product-research): Data-driven product hunting, supplier sourcing, and Amazon FBA listing optimization.
